lookback_minutes.description: A question's window starts this long before the first symptom
lookback_minutes.title: Lookback Minutes

max_hops.description: Topology hops from an anchor entity
max_hops.title: Max Hops

max_requests_per_round.description: Cap on validation requests per collaboration round, across all agents (nearest first)
max_requests_per_round.title: Max Requests Per Round

lead_patterns.description: Regex -> entity type. An agent answering a question proposes as new leads the ids these patterns find in its evidence (e.g. a route table id inside a CloudTrail request).
lead_patterns.title: Lead Patterns

probes.description: Entity type -> domains that can be asked about an entity of that type
probes.title: Probes

signal_roles.description: Signal name (raw or catalog) -> role. A signal that is a cause in one fault and a symptom in another is left out; time precedence and topology decide it.
signal_roles.title: Signal Roles
